phases.title: Working tree is committed and green: user commits the 9 uncommitted reviewer-Write files, then `npm run verify` passes on the committed state (baseline for all later measurements)

Reviewer Write flow is confirmed locally at $0: reproduce a review from a fixture (`node fixtures/materialize.mjs`), check that `answer.json` is written by the reviewer, `route next` records it and prints the report, and that the `agent_type` field is actually present in the hook payload (otherwise the guard rule fails open)

Paid plugin arm is measured: after approval, `npm run build && npm run evals -- --runs 3` (about $6); read aggregate-result.json and report the overall score against the 0.985 pre-ux and 0.879 post-ux scores, with failing graders per case

Review cost is back to the pre-ux level: review-clean about $0.07–0.08/run and reviewer first-call cache write about 5k tokens; if not, find the cause in the traces and make the smallest fix, re-measured with a targeted `--case` run

Rewritten plan/task graders are validated against real traces: check that they pass on good runs and fail on bad ones, fix any grader that does not, and check that Part 4 is present (`part4-fenced` 1.0)

Quality, cost and speed are compared with the bare arm (0.815, $0.0715/run); log the result and any remaining regression in STATE.md, and propose the real run 4 on inseer-frontend from a fresh VS Code
